items.question: Are AI Ads available in my country yet?
items.answer: It depends on the platform: some formats are already live, others are in testing or rolling out country by country. In the initial check I’ll tell you what you can use today and what’s worth preparing for.

items.question: Which businesses is it right for?
items.answer: Mostly businesses selling services or products people ask for advice about: tradespeople, shops, online stores, tourism, professionals. If it isn’t worth it for your industry yet, I’ll say so.

items.question: How much budget do I need?
items.answer: We start with a small test budget, to gather real data before investing more. You get an estimate before we begin.

items.question: Does it replace Google Ads?
items.answer: No, it works alongside it. Google Ads is still essential for people who search the classic way; AI Ads reaches people asking an assistant for advice. Together they cover more of the buying journey.

items.question: How do you measure results?
items.answer: Just like any other campaign: by tracking enquiries and sales on your website, so you know what every cent you invest brings back.

items.question: How much does management cost?
items.answer: A fixed fee, set out in the quote. Never a percentage of your ad budget.
